```{=html}
<section class="funding-page">

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&display=swap');

/* =====================================
   FOND ET DÉCORATIONS
===================================== */

html, body, #quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

.funding-page {
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  color: #293747;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 35px 22px;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.funding-page * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* LAVANDE À DROITE */

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.17;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ÉPI DE BLÉ À GAUCHE */

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.19;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   EN-TÊTE
===================================== */

.funding-header {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 38px;
  padding: 26px 12px 10px;
  overflow: visible;
}

.sac-argent-filigrane {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 25%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 210px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.14;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.funding-eyebrow {
  color: #9b784b;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.funding-header h1 {
  color: #26394d;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 46px);
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.funding-header p {
  color: #59636e;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* =====================================
   CONTENU FINANCEMENT
===================================== */

.funding {
  max-width: 960px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  color: #293747;
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* =====================================
   CARTE UNIFIÉE ANNEAU + LIAISONS
===================================== */

.funding-unified {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%, rgba(180, 147, 99, 0.06), transparent 52%),
              #ffffff;
  padding: 34px 28px 38px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0d8;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(38, 57, 77, 0.06);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.money-flying {
  position: absolute;
  right: 22px;
  top: 12px;
  width: 108px;
  height: 98px;
  opacity: 0.72;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

/* TITRE AU-DESSUS DE L'ANNEAU */

.funding-top-title {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.funding-kicker {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 1.7px;
  color: #9b784b;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.funding-top-title h2 {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 26px;
  color: #26394d;
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* SCÈNE ANNEAU + CÔTÉS EXTÉRIEURS */

.donut-diagram {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 880px;
  height: 310px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.donut-diagram-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  overflow: visible;
}

/* BLOCS EXTÉRIEURS GAUCHE (COMMUNE) & DROITE (DRAC) */

.callout-side {
  position: absolute;
  width: 245px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.callout-left {
  left: 0;
  top: 34px;
  align-items: flex-end;
  text-align: right;
}

.callout-right {
  right: 0;
  top: 136px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  text-align: left;
}

.callout-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.callout-left .callout-head {
  flex-direction: row-reverse;
}

/* DRAPEAU FRANÇAIS */

.french-flag {
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  flex: 0 0 34px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(38, 57, 77, 0.16);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}

.french-flag span {
  flex: 1;
  height: 100%;
}

.french-flag span:nth-child(1) {
  background: #002395;
}

.french-flag span:nth-child(2) {
  background: #ffffff;
}

.french-flag span:nth-child(3) {
  background: #ed2939;
}

.commune-emblem {
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  flex: 0 0 34px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5eee2, #eadbc3);
  border: 1px solid rgba(180, 147, 99, 0.30);
  font-size: 17px;
}

.callout-name {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #26394d;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.callout-amount-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 4px 0 3px;
}

.callout-left .callout-amount-row {
  flex-direction: row-reverse;
}

.callout-amount {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 25px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #26394d;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.funding-pill {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 2px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.funding-pill.drac {
  background: #26394d;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.funding-pill.commune {
  background: #b49363;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.callout-desc {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: #6b7682;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 225px;
}

/* =====================================
   DOCUMENT OFFICIEL
===================================== */

.funding-reference {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding: 17px;
  background: #f7f5f1;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0d8;
  border-left: 4px solid #b49363;
  border-radius: 9px;
  color: #252525;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s;
}

.funding-reference:hover {
  background: #f0ece3;
  border-color: #c5b18e;
}

.reference-icon {
  flex: 0 0 42px;
  height: 42px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  background: #eee8dc;
  border-radius: 9px;
  font-size: 23px;
}

.reference-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.reference-label {
  color: #94764b;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 1.1px;
}

.reference-content strong {
  color: #26394d;
  font-size: 16px;
}

.reference-description {
  color: #596575;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.reference-meeting {
  color: #687585;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-style: italic;
}

.reference-action {
  color: #94764b;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.reference-arrow {
  color: #94764b;
  font-size: 20px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   DESTINATION DE LA COMMANDE
===================================== */

.funding-destination {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.funding-destination > span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 28px;
  color: #a8895d;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.funding-destination > div {
  background: #344e68;
  color: white;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 9px;
}

.funding-destination small {
  color: #d6dce2;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
}

.funding-destination strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 19px;
  margin: 8px 0;
}

.funding-destination p {
  font-size: 13px;
  margin: 0;
  color: #e1e6eb;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE
===================================== */

@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .donut-diagram {
    height: auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 18px;
  }

  .donut-diagram-svg {
    width: 260px;
    height: 260px;
  }

  .connector-lines {
    display: none;
  }

  .callout-side {
    position: static;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 420px;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding-top: 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid #ece7de;
  }

  .callout-left .callout-head,
  .callout-left .callout-amount-row {
    flex-direction: row;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 750px) {

  .funding-page {
    padding: 25px 12px;
  }

  .sac-argent-filigrane {
    width: 165px;
    top: 30%;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.13;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {

  .funding-unified {
    padding: 24px 16px 28px;
  }

  .money-flying {
    width: 68px;
    height: 62px;
    right: 8px;
    top: 8px;
    opacity: 0.42;
  }

  .funding-top-title h2 {
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .funding-reference {
    padding: 13px;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .reference-icon {
    flex-basis: 35px;
    height: 35px;
    font-size: 20px;
  }

  .reference-label {
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .funding-destination > div {
    padding: 17px;
  }
}

/* =====================================
   IMPRESSION
===================================== */

@media print {

  .lavande-filigrane,
  .ble-filigrane,
  .sac-argent-filigrane {
    display: none;
  }

}
</style>

<section class="funding">

  <div class="funding-unified">

    <!-- ARGENT QUI S'ENVOLE -->

         viewBox="0 0 150 120"
         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
         aria-hidden="true">

      <g transform="rotate(-18 75 55)">

        <path d="M39 15 L42 22 L49 25 L42 28 L39 35 L36 28 L29 25 L36 22 Z"/>

    </svg>

    <!-- TITRE AU-DESSUS DE L'ANNEAU -->
    <div class="funding-top-title">
      <span class="funding-kicker">Répartition des financements</span>
      <h2>Deux financeurs publics</h2>
    </div>

    <!-- ANNEAU AU CENTRE + LÉGENDES RELIÉES SUR LES CÔTÉS -->
    <div class="donut-diagram">

      <!-- SVG CENTRAL : ANNEAU + TEXTE CENTRAL + LIGNES DE LIAISON -->
      <svg class="donut-diagram-svg"
           viewBox="0 0 880 310"
           role="img"
           aria-label="Graphique anneau du financement : coût global de 200 000 €, dont 25 % Commune de Grignan (50 000 €) et 75 % DRAC (150 000 €)">

        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="gradDrac" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3c5a78"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#223344"/>
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id="gradCommune" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#caa773"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#9e7b49"/>
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>

        <!-- Disque intérieur doux -->
        <circle cx="440" cy="155" r="88"
                fill="#fcfaf6"
                stroke="#ece6db"
                stroke-width="1.5"/>

        <!-- Piste de fond -->
        <circle cx="440" cy="155" r="110"
                fill="none"
                stroke="#f1ede5"
                stroke-width="30"/>

        <!-- Anneau (rayon = 110, circonférence ≈ 691.15) -->
        <g transform="rotate(-90 440 155)">
          <!-- DRAC : 75% de 691.15 = 518.36 -->
          <circle cx="440" cy="155" r="110"
                  fill="none"
```
